idea-plugin.name: Gopher Burrow
idea-plugin.description:
Dark theme for GoLand, built on Islands Dark.

  • Colors tuned for Go and most popular languages.
  • Made for GoLand, but I've also tried it in IntelliJ IDEA, Rider, RustRover and CLion, so it should look good there too.

Source code and issues on GitHub. Stars make the gopher happy.

Not affiliated with or endorsed by Google, the Go project or JetBrains.
idea-plugin.change-notes: Rust, C/C++, Kotlin and PowerShell now use the theme palette instead of their own colors, so types, functions, fields and constants look the same as in Go.
